title: Phlebotomist's Cabinet
subtitle: Clinical blood study
text: Three distinct sources, properly examined. A specimen without provenance is refuse. A collection without order is merely a cupboard full of coagulation. Your Cabinet recipe is now recorded. Its nine pigeonholes each hold 64 full vials of one component-identical specimen. Source, identification, names, and every other component must match. Click a vial into a cell; click with an empty cursor to withdraw one. Fit a clear glass pane for viewing; sneak-use a Knapper to remove it. Craft a Cabinet, then store and withdraw a sample.
